responsibility: This header supplies the generic ELF object-format configuration for the AArch64 backend. It defines assembler syntax and section directives, constructor/destructor emission via .init_array/.fini_array, jump-table and alignment output helpers, default ABI and endianness driver self-specs, and assembler option specs, thereby connecting the machine backend to the generic ELF toolchain conventions used by multiple AArch64 OS targets.
